newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nomura Securities slip slightly on media report.
newsitem.headline: Nomura Securities slip slightly on media report.

text.p: Nomura Securities Co Ltd shares were slightly lower in Tuesday afternoon trade following media reports that prosecutors are expected to start searching the brokerage's headquarters as early as Tuesday, brokers said.
The shares closed down 20 yen at 1,440.
The report by Kyodo news agency could not be immediately confirmed.
Brokers said the impact of the news was not very big, as it was something the market had been expecting.
"What the market is more concerned about is any punitive measures which will be taken against the brokerage," Yasuo Ueki, Nikko Securities Co Ltd general manager, said.
"The punishment will probably have an effect on the firm's business and could have an impact on the whole brokerage industry as well," Ueki said.
Nomura is facing an investigation into a scandal over its suspected illegal payments to a corporate client.
